title: Fix pokemon display names, sword/shield filters, and modal encounter issues
body:
This commit addresses the following issues:
1. Re-arranges the pokemon name rendering to display the main name in English and the supplementary name in Russian, updating both the list and the modal.
2. Expands the Game Filter logic in the GraphQL query. Now it checks not only for encounters but also flavor texts and moves, solving the issue where pokemon in certain games (e.g. Sword/Shield) would not show up.
3. Fixes a crash that occurs when the PokeAPI returns null location areas for legendary pokemon, ensuring the modal renders correctly without filtering by game.
